# libminer

libminer helps you understand the R package libraries installed on your
machine: how many packages you have, how much space they take up, and
when you installed them.

## Installation

You can install the development version of libminer from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("agneke/libminer")
```

## Example

[`lib_summary()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_summary.md)
counts (and optionally sizes) the packages in each of your library
paths:

``` r

library(libminer)

lib_summary()
#>                                                                Library
#> 1                                   C:/Program Files/R/R-4.6.0/library
#> 2                       C:/Users/Admin/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.6
#> 3 C:/Users/Admin/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpWegzUx/temp_libpath7d787d21c88
#>   n_packages
#> 1         30
#> 2        298
#> 3          1
lib_summary(sizes = TRUE)
#>                                                                Library
#> 1                                   C:/Program Files/R/R-4.6.0/library
#> 2                       C:/Users/Admin/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.6
#> 3 C:/Users/Admin/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpWegzUx/temp_libpath7d787d21c88
#>   n_packages lib_size
#> 1         30   75.65M
#> 2        298  741.42M
#> 3          1   36.54K
```

[`lib_starburst()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_starburst.md)
turns that summary into a colorful starburst plot, with one wedge per
library:

``` r

lib_starburst()
```

![](reference/figures/README-starburst-1.png)

[`lib_timeline()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_timeline.md)
shows *when* you installed each package, using the modification time of
each package’s `DESCRIPTION` file as its install date — handy for
spotting bursts of installation activity (a new course, a new project)
versus quiet stretches:

``` r

lib_timeline()
```

![](reference/figures/README-timeline-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`lib_starburst()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_starburst.md)
  : Plot your R libraries as a starburst
- [`lib_summary()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_summary.md)
  : R Library Summary
- [`lib_timeline()`](https://agneke.github.io/libminer/reference/lib_timeline.md)
  : Plot a timeline of when your packages were installed
